title: senegalia palawanensis
intro: Senegalia palawanensis, commonly known as the Palawan Acacia, is a species of tree in the family Fabaceae. It is a plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Senegalia palawanensis include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the healing process and provide relief from symptoms. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
